input.question: Can I use my company logo as AI inspiration and expect an exact copy?

The AI may incorporate elements of the design, color scheme, or layout, but the output is not a precise duplicate. 

For specific requirements about artwork uploads (e.g., file format, size, ratio), refer to the [designs section](tablecards.designs). If you need exact logo reproduction, consider using a custom design template instead.
